svg.title: Community and optional Cloud hosting management
svg.desc: The local app implements start and move requests to Cloud. Hosting control and ordinary Community participation have separate authority. Move archives go from the local server directly to the returned Community upload target. Contract support does not establish deployment availability.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local DorkOS app + server
Start / move UI + Cloud relay implemented
Agents execute here

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional Cloud hosting management
Public /v1/communities contract
Availability checked independently

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Host administration API
Scoped machine keys · owner claims
Lifecycle · limits · usage · holds
Notice-gated community deletion
